name: Spokeo
steps: Search your name on Spokeo and open the listing that matches you
Copy the listing URL into Unlist
Open the opt-out page and paste the listing URL or enter your details
Complete the CAPTCHA yourself
Click the confirmation link in the email they send
Search again in a few days to check that the listing is gone

name: Whitepages
steps: Search your name on Whitepages and copy your listing URL

Enter the code from the call to finish
